paragraphs.text: Live CPU and memory meter for the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar
# Sidebar system monitor

A Harness Web UI plugin that shows live CPU, memory, root-disk, and `/tmp` load
at the bottom of the

left sidebar, in the footer strip beside the Cordis panel
action and above Settings.

- **Wide sidebar**: a 2×2 grid — `CPU ▓▓ 34%`, `MEM ▓▓ 65%`, `DISK ▓▓ 38G`,
`TMP ▓ 7G` — in the foot

er strip, beside the Cordis panel action and above
Settings.
- **Collapsed rail**: compact `CPU` / `

MEM` / `DSK` / `TMP` lines.
- Hover the meter for `CPU 34% · memory 65% · disk 38.2 of 98.0 GB free

· /tmp 7.1 of 7.9 GB free`.
- Bars shift accent → amber at the warning threshold → red at the critic

al one.
- Updates on the configured interval; pauses while the tab is hidden and keeps
the last good

sample when a request fails.
- **⋯ button** in the meter opens a quick popover with on/off switches

for
CPU, Memory, Disk, and `/tmp` — the same live values as the Settings page.
- **Settings → Plugi
ns → System monitor** configures every parameter live.
## Settings

Everything is optional; the defaults below apply until the profile overrides a
field. Open **Setting

s → Plugins → System monitor** and change a control — the
write is live (no restart) and persists in
the profile configuration.
| Setting | Default | Meaning |

| `refreshMs` | `2000` | Poll interval in ms, 500–60000 |
| `showCpu` | `true` | Render the CPU lane

|
| `showMem` | `true` | Render the memory lane |
| `showDisk` | `true` | Render the root-disk lane

|
| `showTmp` | `true` | Render the `/tmp` lane |
| `diskPath` | `/` | Filesystem the DISK lane mea

sures |
| `tmpPath` | `/tmp` | Filesystem the TMP lane measures (falls back to `os.tmpdir()`) |
| `w

arnPct` | `60` | Used-percent that turns a bar amber |
| `errorPct` | `85` | Used-percent that turns

0` | Used-percent that turns a bar amber |
| `errorPct` | `85` | Used-percent that turns a bar red |
## How it works
| Half | File | Role |
| Host | `index.js` | Registers the authenticated read-only route `GET /api/sysmon.load` on the shar
ed Connection channel. CPU comes from `os.cpus()` time deltas; memory prefers `/proc/meminfo` `MemAv
ailable` and falls back to `os.totalmem()`/`os.freemem()` elsewhere; disk and `/tmp` capacity come f

rom `fs.statfsSync()` (`/` and `/tmp`, falling back to `os.tmpdir()`). |
| Client | `client.js` | Re
gisters the meter into `sidebar.footer.action` and the page into `settings.plugins.tab`, and polls t
he route. Writes go through the Settings domain's `configForms` service, so revisions and persistenc
e are handled by the Host. Styles use only `--dsw-*` theme tokens; copy is localized through the `sy
smon` namespace (en, zh). |

The route sits behind Connection's browser cookie, so the figures are never
exposed on an unauthenti

ehind Connection's browser cookie, so the figures are never
exposed on an unauthenticated web route.

## Notes

- The sidebar's global panel list has no insert slot, so the apps+ "More"
launcher cannot host extra

rows. This plugin uses the supported footer seat
closest to it instead.
